This repository is AI-first.

Before generating code always follow:

1. AGENTS.md
2. docs/architecture.md
3. docs/coding-standards.md

Never violate architectural boundaries.

Never introduce new dependencies without justification.

Prefer consistency over cleverness.

Generate production-ready code.

Generate tests.

Generate Zod schemas.

Generate documentation when architecture changes.

Never bypass validation.

Never place business logic in UI or API layers.
